notes.title: Big Thanks, Roadmap & Development Update
notes.content:
Eyo community ːsteamhappyː

Two weeks ago, we released our first demo, and your support and feedback have blown us away, and we can't thank you enough.
Your feedback has been [b]gold[/b]! Seriously, we've been going through every comment, suggestion, and bug report. You guys are helping shape the future of Defaced: Dark Abyss, and we're stoked about the improvements coming your way in the full game dropping in a year.

Also, a massive shoutout to all the Let's Players out there. Whether you're a big channel or just starting, watching you explore our game has been a blast. We would love to see more! Btw, you can tag us with [b]#Defaced2024[/b]

And hey, the adventure doesn't stop here. We're committed to keeping you up to date with sneak peeks, a Roadmap, and maybe a surprise or two. We're on this journey together, and we want you right there with us.

Speaking of surprises, wink, there's a chance, not confirmed yet, but there might be a second demo in about six months. We can't promise anything, but we are trying our best!

Thanks again for playing! Stay tuned for all the updates to come.

Cheers,
Jan & Julian from PPG ːsteammockingː


[i]PS: Every Wishlist, Like, Comment, Share and Subscription helps us as a small GameDev Studio A LOT! [/i]

notes.title: Demo Release & Steam Scream Festival
notes.content:
After five weeks of dedicated development, we're thrilled to publish our 'Defaced: Dark Abyss' demo right in time for the Steam Scream Festival [b]on 26. October![/b]
We hope you'll enjoy this sneak peek into the world we've crafted.

As mentioned earlier, we've put this demo together in just about five weeks. It's been a whirlwind journey for me personally, going from knowing nothing about Unreal Engine development to slowly finding my place in this intricate process. Its not always easy as a solo dev ːsteamhappyː

We had bigger plans for this demo, but time, as it often is, proved to be our greatest adversary! ^^

The full release is scheduled for approximately one year from now, and that means many upgrades and exciting features are in the pipeline. [b]Your feedback is absolutely priceless as we embark on creating the main game.
[/b]

We would greatly appreciate your constructive feedback to help us enhance the demo before the full game release! You can connect with us on Twitter at [b]@primephasegames[/b], Instagram at [b]@Primephasegames_Official[/b], and, of course, on [b]Discord[/b] (find the link on our Steam page). Your insights are invaluable to us!



[h2]Thank you for being a part of our journey![/h2]
[b]~ Julian[/b]

#DFCD


ps. Website is coming soon too.

notes.title: Development Update & Outlook on the Future
notes.content:
We are closing in on the first week of the rebrand of Defaced and we could not be more happy. We got very good and constructive feedback which helps heavily with the improvement of the game! <3

Currently we are working very hard on the Demo, which will be released at the end of October! It will give yall a small glimpse of Defaced even though we probably still have over a year of development left, before we can show you everything!

Again, thanks to all of you and we will keep u updated!
~ Julian
